summary: folder-lint preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (_0xNNNN identifiers) and, at npm install time, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs the fresh Bun binary against the adjacent math_init.js file. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte '// @bun @bun-cjs' bundle consisting of a single line of obfuscated JavaScript (shuffled string-array with hex constants, mangled identifiers, array-shift rotation) that is not reachable from the advertised library entry (lib/index.js) and is not documented in the README. Executing the payload under a freshly fetched alternate runtime rather than Node bypasses Node-based inspection and installer sandboxing assumptions. The advertised lint API (checkPath/NamingConvention/printFailure) has no functional need for a Bun runtime or a 727KB obfuscated bundle. The package.json also presents author 'ServiceTitan' and homepage github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint, mimicking a real project while the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload are absent from the upstream repository.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
